reviews.title: No free trial opt-out
reviews.text: They force you to opt into their free trial hoping you’ll forget about the subscription so they can charge you. It should be illegal to have to force you to opt in to their free trial. There are no options to start using the app without having first “paid” for the free trial. This is preposterous and honestly just lousy. Very disappointing.

reviews.title: Okay
reviews.text: I like it! But there are some big flaws. Most the perks you need to pay for. If you want to log any symptoms etc from the day before.. you can’t unless you’ve paid. That shouldn’t be a perk! That should be part of the free app. For me it’s not functional if you can’t back log. All the fun extras, you need to pay. I did do the free trial and it was great.. but I don’t want to subscribe. Not paying you still get cute daily updates on your cycle but that’s about it! Can’t really recommend unfortunately.

reviews.title: DO NOT USE ON OLDER PHONE MODELS!!
reviews.text: The app is basically impossible to open on the IPhone SE and it takes at least five minutes. And unfortunately it started getting more reliable for guessing my period and the only app out of five that actually had it down to 2-4 days until my period

reviews.title: never accurate
reviews.text: this app has NEVER ONCE been accurate, for example my periods were consistently on a specific day every single month (which mine are irregular so that was cool lol) and the app would consistently send me messages 2 WEEKS EARLY about “oh no! is your period ghosting you????” like do NOT stress me out like that… insane how people absolutely swear by this app when it’s been extremely inaccurate for me every single month lol

reviews.title: not reliable
reviews.text: it has happened several times that i’ve physically logged my own period, and the app has changed the days, making me wonder why im getting my period twice or three times a month. used to love it, recently ive been very disappointed

reviews.title: Very Confusing
reviews.text: I thought this app would just be actually women based because it was advertised as an alternative to things like Flo & male owned companies & also doesn’t make you pay to know basic information, but it’s just genuinely worse. It’s only appeal is astrology which, I personally do no care for, & nothing else. It just assumes everything about you & your cycle & does not ask any questions or let you log any symptoms for later use & just checking & navigating around this app is just a headache, i genuinely really hate it. But I do like the visuals I guess.

reviews.title: It’s always wrong.
reviews.text: Never gets the date right. And all the benefits are with premium. Not paying for an app that’s stupid.

reviews.title: Such a cool app, if it weren’t for in-app purchases
reviews.text:
Literally eveything is so cool about it, syncing with the moon, the insights, the fact you can track with friends easy and even partners! 
But the need for a subscription is something you genuinely can’t pass without now, it wasn’t like this before. I can’t even see anything or edit any symptoms if it’s not the allotted today insight and symptoms. You can’t go back and forth, like you can only edit your period. Nothing else. Like girl be so for real.

TLDR: This app is so cool with so many cool features, but purchase literally is necessary to have any good features 💔💔

reviews.title: Everything has a price
reviews.text: This app used to be OK, it was always cheesy and clunky to use but I didn’t mind. I could at least track my cycle and go back if I forgot to add an activity but apparently now they want to charge for that also. Deleting this and going back to pen and paper because these apps are either run by evil men or stupid expensive.

reviews.title: Maybe too old
reviews.text: My iPhone could not get this to work, it might be too old.

reviews.title: No comment
reviews.text: I downloaded this app finally after seeing a billion ads about it, and deleted my other app not knowing I would regret it. When I first opened the app it glitched like crazy and I could barely click through the title screen. I brushed it off thinking it was just my phone but then I went in to see when I would get my period next a few weeks later and it logged me out and lost all of my data! I couldn’t log back in and had no idea when I was getting my period! It’s honestly just so annoying. Would not redownload.

reviews.title: Laggy, features taken away, data not safe
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for a while but think I’ll need to stop at this point. Every time I open the app, it’s never guaranteed to load anything. I often have to force close the app and try and reopen it. Most of the time it doesn’t work. I’ve updated it and it’s still glitchy and laggy. They’ve taken away so many elements and features and the first thing you see when you open the app and scroll down is essentially an effort to get you to pay for the premium features. It’s cute that they want to incorporate all of these other elements but why take away parts of the info they used to provide in order to do that? Every time I open the app it seems like there is something different about it. I don’t even use most of the app anymore because it’s constantly changing and like I said, doesn’t even load half the time. This app was also voted one of the worst period tracking apps for privacy and data security. They claim they don’t sell your data but they WILL give up your info to authorities if it is requested. They also claim no identifying info is included when that info is shared but seems like it would defeat the purpose of it if no identifying information was included… we have a literal dictator in office but they want to make it easier for our health information to be accessed by those in power wanting to use that information against a population that is already at risk. Stardust does not care about its users.

reviews.title: Logged out and tracking lost
reviews.text: I’ve been using Stardust for about a year now since I made the switch from another tracking app. I’m confused because I opened the app recently and I was logged out. When I tried logging back in with my usual info it had me restart my tracking journey and I lost all my cycle info from the past year. I don’t understand how this has happened as in even the past week I received BC reminder notifications every day till today.

reviews.title: Another fancy period app - this time astrology coded
reviews.text: If you like fancy graphics with your period - this is the app for you! I was looking for a replacement to Flo and I'm still looking. I like astrology, not religiously but I do like some idea of how to scope my week or day. This is a little egregious however - I open the app and get hit with a sale on just getting my daily horoscope. I mark my period - buy a membership for "insight." Respectfully, I'm bleeding, now isn't a great time to ask me to get out my wallet. Not only that, just to get a "full experience" you have to pay for additional writing for your Rising and other horoscopes. I know that's just the deal we're given these days - everything this a subscription or payment. But I'm pretty disappointed that this was pitched as Flo's successor and it's just a graphic update.

reviews.title: Hate the update
reviews.text: I loved this app and referred it to so many people. Now it doesn’t have my cute little thing it says every day.

reviews.title: Theifs
reviews.text: I was just charged 30 dollars for am end of trail thing. I paid my 6.99 fee and canceled because it’s a bad app. I don’t appreciate my money being stolen like this.

reviews.title: Ultimately useless!
reviews.text: After tracking my period for almost two years, during my perimenopause journey, it logged me out one day. When I logged back in, I was a brand new user again. All my saved data was gone! The whole reason for using this app, just erased. I will deleting this useless app, immediately.

reviews.title: Needs more inclusivity
reviews.text: I used to love this app! But as someone who no longer has a period due to hormonal medication, I find it really strange they have no way to track through your cycle without detecting bleeding. Many women no longer have a period due to so many health reasons and birth controls, but still find it important to know what phase of the cycle you are on. Makes me really sad because I love all other parts of this app but without bleeding it keeps me in the lutheal phase and says that I am late always. There’s a million other symptoms women have that can help predict where they are in their cycle. To come back to this app, I would need them to update this. This is sad to me because I loved the design and a ton of other aspects but now it’s basically unusable for me. Clue the other period app is a great example of being more inclusive with this, but they don’t have half of the great things stardust has so it is not my preference, but out of necessity i have to use that one now.

reviews.title: Scam?
reviews.text: After accepting the free trial, it didn’t show up in the App Store to cancel. Got a fraud alert on our card.

reviews.title: where’s my account??
reviews.text: i had an account for about 2 years and i went to track my period and i had to sign in again and when i did it said i didn’t have an account? i know what email i used but my account is just gone and i lost everything. i want my account back

reviews.title: Loved it but not anymore
reviews.text: I loved this app and all of the insight Id get based off my information, and I had used it for probably about two years on the free version. They now don’t allow the free version and all of my information is gone and it’s as if I’m a new account. I would’ve paid for the new cost if they had kept my information but I might as well start with a new app now since it appears as if I’m a new user. Bummed

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: The app told me it would let me know before the billing cycle started and it never did and took the annual fee out. I HAD to start a free trial to use the app and gave me no heads up before the billing cycle continued. to cancel it i had to go to a whole separate website not on the apple subscription page. be careful it will steal $30 from you

reviews.title: Postpartum mode doesn't work
reviews.text: Postpartum mode does not work. It won't let you finish set up, I've tried deleting the app and reinstalling. Also tried setting it up under cycle tracking then switching to postpartum once it was set up and that doesn't work either. It's telling me my period is four days late but I'm postpartum and not expecting a period 😕

reviews.title: “Period having people”
reviews.text: I’ve always used this app to track my periods and it’s my favourite. I like keeping up with the moon cycles and love the new tarot feature. Also, I adore the fact that your app is woman-founded and led. HOWEVER, I’m confused as to why in today’s “period fact” of the day, you used the term “period having people”. You mean women, right? Only women experience menstrual cycles, so why are you using terms like that? Isn’t this app for women? Do you consider men bleeding out of their makeshift penises “period having people”? Because that is not what a period is. Thanks.

reviews.title: don’t buy the subscription for stardust plus.
reviews.text: used to love this app. bought the yearly subscription and it keeps telling me i didn’t buy it and won’t let me restore my purchase no matter how many times i manage it or activate it on the app. also won’t let me update my email after verifying it and everything it still shows up as the old email. this app sucks now too many bugs too slow too laggy and they’re just money hungry now instead of focusing on women’s periods

reviews.title: Just
reviews.text: I hate this app because it said I needed an apple account and it won’t let me use google like what type of app doesn’t let you use google

reviews.title: Too extra.
reviews.text: Too many bells and whistles on this app if you ask me. I would probably be better off just using a regular calendar to track my periods. In addition, it’s very irritating they use the phrasing “ people with periods” because last I checked only women specifically can have periods. Such nonsense.

reviews.title: Data loss
reviews.text: I’ve seen a few reviews stating the same thing .. been using the app for a solid year always been great but now if just resets every week which is useless

I just wanted to track my cycle and enjoy some astrology as well! That was the main reason I left FLO and downloaded this app! No paywall! Amazing features! But like always companies get greedy. Smh.

reviews.title: Restricting previously free features is a really bad idea
reviews.text: You used to be able to "look ahead" (literally just scroll forward thru the cycle) in the tracker for free, but now you need a premium subscription to do so. Not a fan of that.

reviews.title: Stardust Sucks at tracking
reviews.text: If i could give no stars i would!!! The app does NOT track your period properly. Says ovulation is started when i started my period????  its every cycle not this one only.

reviews.title: Not good for irregular cycles and extremely laggy
reviews.text: Had a period that lasted an entire month, which was very irregular, and now that I’m actually off my period, Stardust continues to notify me that my period is “late”? Even though it very obviously lasted for a month straight. Now, all it says is that my period should start tomorrow, continuing to push back each and every single day. If the app does not go back to normal after I log my next period, I’m going to be severely disappointed. In addition to this, the app is intolerably laggy and oftentimes freezes my entire phone upon opening it or trying to use any of its features.

reviews.title: Not a fan
reviews.text: Only allows you to make an account through Apple. Period tracking is inaccurate and it is promoting witch/ occult themes

reviews.text: It won’t allow me to toggle the Apple Motion Tracking for sleep - also ALL sleep data is now nowhere to be found? It used to tell me how I was doing based on Apple Health Sleep data, but that section is now nowhere to be found.  Whats going on?

reviews.title: hope you can afford the subscription, else it’s not worth it
reviews.text: over the last year, more features have been added overall (some of which are cute like tarot and astrology but pretty unrelated to cycle tracking). that’s cool but i personally only cared about the symptom/cycle tracking, education on hormones and symptoms, and sleep insights. welp, as of the most recent update, the only thing you can do for free is log your symptoms. you can’t see what they might mean. you can’t actually read your cycle insights anymore, so why even bother logging them. you can’t even read the cutesy little tarot cards. this isn’t very girls’ girl behavior, js.

reviews.title: Do not trust this app
reviews.text: They claim a high level of data protection, but it is not true on multiple levels. They randomly lost all of my health data. I had been taking the time to track cycles for a year prior and it is completely gone one day with no explanation or reasoning found by their team. I would not trust them with your sensitive health data - look into their privacy claims as well.

I have been going back and forth with their customer support for about a week now: supplying emails, phone number, my friend code, and they can’t find it either. Don’t start tracking because it may suddenly be gone 🤷🏻‍♀️

It’s crazy to me. You’d think an app made by a woman, so they say, wouldn’t care about the money and would instead just simply care about helping other women out. but no. of course it’s all about money.

I kept talking about it to others, sharing my funny notifications and really selling it to all my friends and family. And now, all the features are behind a paywall, even the basics. Also where is the ‘go to today’ button when I scroll the timeline; or the quick logging of symptoms. I just don’t know why I should still be using it.

I just find it weird and completely unnecessary especially for those who have recovered from an eating disorder

reviews.title: Uninclusive app
reviews.text: Im a trans man and looking for a period app, thought this app would be good cause it was all spacey and stuff and i like space and alien related things, but this app just is stereotypical and calls you a “girl” and “woman” and im sick of this world constantly misgendering people, it could of been good just calling you “person” or something like that! And saying their next update would be more “gender neutral” when its not!! Im starting to hate this app the more i use it and the more it uses me.

reviews.title: Not great

Takes a minute to even open up due to all the animations. Often my historical data just disappears. It’s pretty and has lots of useful additional info but the basics are not covered. I need it to open quick, show me what I need quick, track my period and not lose the history. On those things it often fails.

reviews.title: Toooooo slow
reviews.text: Why is this app so slow? It takes one minute to load and there is no update available so I’m not on an old version. Please do something!!

reviews.title: confusing and overdone
reviews.text: I downloaded the app after researching apps that protected users privacy, post the removal of roe v wade. This was highly recommended for its privacy policy, which they also take time to explain when first creating your account. I wish i could like the app as it tries to do many fun things with its design, but it’s all way too much. it uses a confusing horoscope inspired design for absolutely everything, the navigation is confusing as they value aesthetics over clear understandable ui. it’s made it so hard to become familiar with the app, as the very basic things become buried under all the glitz. after switching from my old app and tirelessly inputing years of data, it still miscalculated my period date and I ended up getting my period while out and completely unprepared. let’s not forget the useless daily notifications that say nothing of use. Bought a years subscription on accident so i’m stuck with it. The App could use a redesign for usability, and to perhaps remember that it is simply supposed to be a period app above everything else.

reviews.title: not good for irregular cycles
reviews.text: i hate to give a female owned period tracker a bad review, but it’s just really not worked for my irregular periods. despite on the initial download specifying my periods were irregular and i was on a medication which meant irregular periods, after one 14 day period it decided that meant my literal phase was about 3 weeks long and my follicular was 1 day, which doesn’t reflect my mood or symptoms at all. i reached out to customer support, maybe it didn’t go through, but after a couple months nothing has changed. i really wanted to like this but it hasn’t worked for me

reviews.title: awful
reviews.text: literally never got when my periods were going to be right which is the ENTIRE POINT of the app.

reviews.title: ai is taking over
reviews.text: i’ve used this app for years it’s fun, it’s creative, its quirky and pretty accurate but i can’t with the use of ai, i understand its inevitable and slowly seeping into everything but this just seems to directly go against what you preach, im going to have to find another app or start tracking my cycle by hand, it’s probably best for me

reviews.title: Not that good at tracking cycle, better then flow ig
reviews.text: The biggest problem they have is bc they’re exactly like flow except not owned by men selling our cycle data. They track our cycle exactly like flo, using overall numbers of our entire cycle instead of our biology of each phase. For example if your period was longer then usual it will mark your follicular phase as 1-3 days which is extremely unrealistic to what our cycle actually does when it last longer. It will mark your period as late even tho your entire cycle was late bc u had a longer period. Our body doesn’t WORK in overall cycle length numbers!!! Those are just averages based on hundred of women cycles, the ai that predicts should know that if our cycle is lasting longer we’re not late to our next period, we’re just having a longer cycle. It shouldn’t use average number of overall cycles from studies but instead use our biology studies that our cycles phases still last a certain amount of days not that our ENTIRE cycle must fit the average number or it’s late even though even if your period is late, your cycle will also be late. I love the app and the theme but disappointed they measure our period the SAME as men, each phase of our cycles has average amount of day it shouldn’t be measured by length of ENTIRE cycles but by length of each phase.

reviews.title: Lost all my data
reviews.text: I was loving the app until I updated it and lost all my data from the last two years!! I had contacted customer support and they have not been helpful at all. Not happy with the app at all.
